robot: SimplerEnv (ManiSkill2_real2sim, SAPIEN 2.2.2): Google Robot / WidowX 250s, official episodes
urdf_note: twin kinematics only: arm links/joints are identical across the 4 recolored urdf_versions (visual colors differ)
letterbox_note: official camera image (640x512 Google / 640x480 WidowX, real-image overlay in Visual Matching) scaled to 512 px wide and padded top/bottom to 512x512 (no crop), intrinsics adjusted exactly
r5_note: facade fixes shared with the RoboTwin backend (closure-stop gripper hold, compliant hold after a stop); no benchmark guide: TASK.md = LIBERO's except the intro paragraph and the relation line
arm_drive_note: harness joint-servo gains (stiffness, damping) on the arm joints, force limits kept official: the official delta-EE controller is bypassed, and the official gains lag a 5 cm/s reference by 3.9 cm (Google) / 1.5 cm (WidowX) vs 2 mm with these, like the RoboTwin backend's 1e4/1e3 drives
robot_base_note: robot_base = the arm mount: Google Robot = joint_torso frame at q=0 (0.5945 m above link_base; table top at z ~ +0.196); WidowX = base_link (on the table; table top at z ~ 0). x forward, y left, z up.
